# Vedantix

Software die meegroeit met jouw bedrijf. Vedantix in Den Bosch builds custom business software for SMEs and independent professionals across all sectors in the Netherlands. AI supports development; Vedantix professionally reviews and tests the result. Websites, hosting and business email remain full services with existing prices.

Custom software: https://vedantix.nl/software-op-maat
About Vedantix: https://vedantix.nl/over-ons
Business scan: https://vedantix.nl/contact#contact-form

Custom software is quoted with startup costs and a fixed monthly amount for agreed functionality, hosting, storage, maintenance and support. Usage, changes, expansion, external subscriptions, security measures and handover/export are agreed beforehand. Named external tools are potential connections to investigate, not delivered integrations or partners. Consult the canonical profiles above for details and limitations.

Marketing is quoted; advertising budgets and external tool/model costs are agreed separately. ChatGPT and Claude are potential tools selected per client with human review before publication.
